entities.name: RutC (Q4ZXR9)
observations: Reviewed RutC reference is an exact full-sequence match; annotated as 3-aminoacrylate deaminase in pyrimidine catabolism.
Catalyzes or facilitates deamination of 3-aminoacrylate to malonic semialdehyde; reaction may also occur spontaneously.
Annotated biological processes include uracil catabolism and nitrogen utilization.

entities.name: Uracil catabolism
observations: RutC reference annotation links this protein to GO:0006212, uracil catabolic process.

observations: RutC reference annotation links this protein to GO:0019740, nitrogen utilization.
